stem.text: The diagram shows the outline structure of two nucleotide bases which occur in DNA.
This pair is held together by two hydrogen bonds, shown as dashed lines.

stem.alt: Skeletal outline of two fused ring structures, one with a five-sided ring and the others six-sided, with two dashed lines between them. Printed labels: "nucleotide 1" below the left structure and "nucleotide 2" to the right.
